local.title: Find on local network
local.description:
Searching continues while this dialog is connected. Choose **Show found devices** at any time to stop searching and inspect the catalog, even if no device has replied. Close this dialog with **×** to cancel.

Active searches share discovery queries every 20 seconds. Joining waits for the next round without sending an extra query; Sent = 0 while waiting is normal. Counters cover only this search's participation: shared UDP submissions, valid replies and distinct devices. Submission is not delivery proof, and replies cannot be attributed to a query. Silence does not prove that no devices are present. The animation illustrates searching, not a verified request/reply exchange.

init.title: Integration settings
init.description:
Choose remote controls, polling and preferences for the next diagnostic capture. Nothing is applied until the final Save; saving preferences alone does not start or stop capture.

[Control help]({control_help_url})

data_description.enable_verified_controls: Enable programme settings and commands for both drums. Remote Control must also be enabled on the machine. Changing this option clears both unsent programme configurations.
data_description.poll_interval: Refresh appliance status every 15–30 seconds. Default: 15 seconds.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Bounded, memory-only integration exchange trace. Budgets and auto-stop are independent: a full store keeps replacing its oldest operations until capture stops. Raw bytes are not a total RAM allowance.

data.start_capture: Start a new diagnostic capture and enable DEBUG

data_description.diagnostic_operations: 1–1800 polls or control attempts, including the current operation. Default: 1800.
data_description.diagnostic_events: 1–18000 event records across retained operations. Default: 18000.
data_description.diagnostic_raw_bytes: 1–8388608 bytes (maximum 8 MiB). Default: 4194304 bytes (4 MiB). Enter an exact whole number of bytes.
data_description.diagnostic_duration: A separate finite deadline for every new capture. Default: 6 hours.
data_description.start_capture: Starts only after final confirmation and replaces the previous trace. Leave unchecked to save preferences only. Trace may include original local addresses, MAC/device identifiers and bytes; review before sharing.

confirm.title: Review integration settings
confirm.description: Review the changes and selected action below. Nothing is applied before final confirmation.

data_description.controls_change: Clears both unsent programme configurations and reloads a loaded integration entry.
data_description.estimated_seconds: Uses 10 events and 266 raw bytes per reference poll at the selected interval. Disabled automatic polling gives 0: there is no active poll source, not a forecast for control-only traffic. Larger exchanges and commands shorten this estimate; capacity is not the auto-stop deadline or a guarantee.
data_description.capture_preferences: Any current capture keeps its recorded data, effective limits and deadline unchanged.
data_description.capture_replacement: Download useful evidence first. Trace may contain original addresses, identifiers and bytes: review before sharing. An external logging change can leave DEBUG enabled after capture stops; use native Disable debug logging to turn it off.

enabled_functions.name: Cycle options
enabled_functions.description: Complete list of enabled source-offered boolean options. Eco. wash, Night wash and Soak wash are incompatible with ordinary stains and are rejected when explicitly requested.

stains.name: Stains
stains.description: For a supported ordinary programme, choose at most one of blood, grass, wine, juice, soil or milk; the treatment fixes temperature and wash-stage duration and excludes Eco. wash, Night wash and Soak wash. For a smart washing fabric recipe, choose one or more W1 through W30 IDs. An empty list selects no stain.
